_note: Sites the pipeline cannot read for you, so you check them by hand. Shown in the dashboard's Manual Sites tab. Edit freely: add an entry, or delete one. 'why' is the honest reason it is not automatic. 'searchUrl' is optional and {query} becomes the target title you pick. Checked September 2026.

sites.name: Bdjobs
sites.why: Cloudflare bot protection. Automated requests get an empty page, so the automatic source was switched off.
sites.note: The largest Bangladeshi board, strongest for corporate and MNC jobs.

sites.name: LinkedIn Jobs
sites.why: Its terms and robots.txt forbid automated access, so it is never scraped.
sites.note: Set a daily job alert and let it email you instead: the README explains the email route.

sites.name: Indeed
sites.why: Its terms forbid automated access and it answers bots with an error page, so it is never scraped.
sites.note: Also works well with a daily email alert.

sites.name: NextJobz (IT jobs)
sites.why: No structured job data. Reading it would mean scraping page markup, which breaks whenever the site is redesigned.
sites.note: Software, network and IT roles from Bangladeshi companies.

sites.name: Skill.Jobs
sites.why: A script-driven page with no structured job data.
sites.note: A skill-first board with government job listings.

sites.name: Techntalents
sites.note: IT jobs with automated CV screening.

sites.name: Job.com.bd
sites.note: Known for government circulars as well as private jobs.

sites.name: Shomvob
sites.note: Mostly entry-level and skill-based jobs, less corporate.

sites.name: Chakri.com
sites.why: The server returned an error (HTTP 523) when checked, so it may be down. It could work for you.
sites.note: A well-known board with circulars from many sectors.

sites.name: Careerjet Bangladesh
sites.why: An aggregator with its own partner terms for programmatic access.
sites.note: Useful as a second opinion: it collects postings from many sites.

sites.name: Road to SDET (QA jobs)
sites.why: QA and SDET jobs only, and its job links cannot be verified automatically (every address shows the same page).
sites.note: Worth a look if you want a QA role.

sites.name: BD Govt Jobs (private circulars)
sites.why: Republishes circulars as its own articles instead of linking to the employer, so its links are not real postings.
sites.note: Useful for bank, NGO and company management-trainee circulars. Follow the apply link inside each article.

sites.name: JobsBD Works
sites.why: Republishes circulars, and its job data is not exposed for software.
sites.note: Government, private, bank and NGO circulars.

sites.name: eJobsCircular
sites.why: Republishes circulars as its own articles.
sites.note: Organised by government, bank, company and NGO jobs.

sites.name: CircularBD
sites.why: Republishes circulars as its own articles.
sites.note: Government, bank, NGO and private vacancies.

sites.name: Bengal Informer (private circulars)
sites.why: Republishes circulars as its own articles.
sites.note: Private-sector circulars including IT and pharma.

sites.name: OnlineJobBD
sites.why: Its job data is not exposed for software, and its feed had not updated since 1 August when checked.

sites.name: Brain Station 23 careers
sites.why: Its openings are drawn by a script on the easy.jobs hiring page, so there is no job data to read.
sites.note: A large Dhaka software company that hires developers, QA and analysts.

sites.name: Innolytic IT Ltd. careers
sites.why: The careers address in the config no longer resolves, so this is a search instead.
sites.note: Where you interned. Worth asking them directly, too.

automatic.name: BDRecruit
automatic.note: Read through its public WordPress API.

automatic.name: BD Tech Jobs
automatic.note: Read from the schema.org job data on its homepage.

automatic.name: We Work Remotely
automatic.note: Six category feeds, limited to jobs anyone worldwide may take.
